items.title: AMD rides data center riches to 'largest and most profitable' quarter in history
items.raw_content: AMD CEO Lisa Su said in the company's quarterly earnings call on Tuesday that Q3 2026 was "was the largest and most profitable in our history." AMD reported a record $13.4 billion in quarterly revenue, and it's predicting it will hit another record high next quarter of $17 billion. The company's data center business is […]
items.title_zh: AMD 借数据中心业务创下史上“最大且最盈利”季度
items.summary: AMD CEO Lisa Su said Q3 2026 was the company's largest and most profitable quarter, with record revenue of $13.4 billion and guidance for a new record of $17 billion next quarter, driven by its data center business.

items.title: Will US midterm results lead to disruption in Washington’s ties with China?
items.raw_content:

The United States’ midterm elections are unlikely to deliver a “disruptive” shock to relations between Beijing and Washington despite potential volatility over the issue of Taiwan, according to a prominent Chinese expert in US studies.
Chen Dongxiao, president of the Shanghai Institutes for International Studies, said any shift in the make-up of the US Congress would mainly complicate...

items.summary: Chen Dongxiao, president of the Shanghai Institutes for International Studies, told SCMP that US midterm results are unlikely to deliver a disruptive shock to Beijing-Washington ties, though Taiwan could add volatility.

items.title: China training Solomon Islands police to use water cannons under security pact
items.raw_content:
China is helping to train Solomon Islands police to use water cannons as part of an ongoing security partnership that is viewed with scepticism by the West.
The Chinese embassy said on Tuesday that six officers from the Royal Solomon Islands Police Force took part in a week-long training exercise, without giving dates.
The programme helped familiarise officers with the use of crowd control vehicles and different scenarios in which they may be used, the embassy said.
The programme cultivated a...
items.title_zh: 中国根据安全协议训练所罗门群岛警察使用水炮
items.summary: China is training Royal Solomon Islands Police Force officers to use water cannons and crowd-control vehicles under an ongoing security partnership that the West views with scepticism, the Chinese embassy said.
